title: 跨部門溝通
description: 與其他部門協調合作的用語

sentences.en: Let me loop in the marketing team on this.
sentences.zh: 讓我把行銷團隊也加進來討論這件事。

sentences.en: We need to coordinate with the engineering department.
sentences.zh: 我們需要和工程部門協調。

sentences.en: I'll follow up with the design team on the timeline.
sentences.zh: 我會跟設計團隊確認時程。

sentences.en: Can we align on the project goals before moving forward?
sentences.zh: 在繼續之前，我們能先對齊專案目標嗎？

sentences.en: I've scheduled a cross-team meeting for Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我已經安排了週四的跨部門會議。

sentences.en: Who's the point of contact in the finance department?
sentences.zh: 財務部門的聯繫窗口是誰？

sentences.en: We need buy-in from the sales team before we proceed.
sentences.zh: 在我們繼續之前，需要得到業務團隊的支持。

sentences.en: Let's set up a sync meeting with all stakeholders.
sentences.zh: 讓我們和所有利害關係人安排一個同步會議。

sentences.en: Could you share this update with your team?
sentences.zh: 你能把這個更新分享給你的團隊嗎？

sentences.en: I'll keep you in the loop on any changes.
sentences.zh: 有任何變動我會隨時通知你。

sentences.en: We're waiting on feedback from the legal department.
sentences.zh: 我們在等法務部門的回覆。

sentences.en: This requires input from multiple departments.
sentences.zh: 這需要多個部門的意見。

sentences.en: Let's make sure everyone is on the same page.
sentences.zh: 讓我們確保所有人的認知一致。

sentences.en: I'll send out a summary to all the teams involved.
sentences.zh: 我會把摘要發給所有相關團隊。

sentences.en: Can we get the IT team's approval on this?
sentences.zh: 我們能取得資訊部門的核准嗎？

sentences.en: There's a dependency on the operations team for this task.
sentences.zh: 這項任務與營運團隊有相依性。

sentences.en: I'll escalate this to both department heads.
sentences.zh: 我會將這件事向兩個部門主管呈報。

sentences.en: We need to bridge the gap between product and engineering.
sentences.zh: 我們需要消除產品和工程之間的落差。

sentences.en: Let's consolidate feedback from all departments.
sentences.zh: 讓我們彙整所有部門的意見回饋。

sentences.en: Can you check with your team and get back to me?
sentences.zh: 你能和你的團隊確認後再回覆我嗎？

sentences.en: We should involve HR in this discussion.
sentences.zh: 我們應該讓人資部門參與這個討論。

sentences.en: The handoff to the QA team needs to happen by Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 交接給品保團隊需要在週三前完成。

sentences.en: I'll arrange a joint review session with both teams.
sentences.zh: 我會安排兩個團隊的聯合檢討會議。

sentences.en: Please keep the other departments informed of any delays.
sentences.zh: 如有延遲，請通知其他部門。

sentences.en: We've reached a consensus across all teams.
sentences.zh: 我們已經在所有團隊間達成共識。

sentences.en: The project requires close collaboration between R&D and production.
sentences.zh: 這個專案需要研發和生產部門密切合作。

sentences.en: Let's clarify each team's responsibilities before we start.
sentences.zh: 開始之前讓我們先釐清各團隊的職責。

sentences.en: I've copied the relevant teams on this email.
sentences.zh: 我已經把相關團隊加入這封信的副本了。

sentences.en: We need a unified approach across all departments.
sentences.zh: 我們需要所有部門採取一致的做法。

sentences.en: Let's schedule a follow-up meeting to track progress.
sentences.zh: 讓我們安排一個後續會議來追蹤進度。
